{"id":"persona-5s4b.65","title":"async-trait and tonic are required to implement these public traits but neither crate re-exports them","description":"Two public extension points force the implementor onto a specific upstream crate version with no re-export to pin against:

1. persona-attestors/src/lib.rs:107 — `Attestor` is declared with `#[async_trait::async_trait]`. The macro rewrites method signatures to return `Pin<Box<dyn Future>>`, so an implementor must apply the same macro from a semver-compatible async-trait, but persona-attestors does not re-export it (lib.rs:12-22 re-exports only the concrete attestors and `probe_sources`). A downstream crate must add its own `async-trait` dependency and guess the version; if the resolver picks a different major, the impl fails to compile with an error that does not mention the version mismatch. Fix: `pub use async_trait::async_trait;` from persona-attestors and say in the trait docs that implementors must use it.

2. persona-grpc/src/service.rs:39 and server.rs:14 — `WorkloadApiService` implements the generated `SpiffeWorkloadApi` trait and `serve()` takes it, so any caller wiring up the server needs matching tonic and prost. persona-grpc re-exports neither; `pub mod workload` (lib.rs:8-10) exposes the generated types, which embed prost types in their public fields, making prost a public dependency of persona-grpc without being declared as one to the caller.

Both are the same class of commitment: an upstream major bump becomes a persona major bump, and today a caller cannot even discover which version to match without reading Cargo.lock.","status":"open","priority":2,"issue_type":"task","owner":"mark@reviewcommit.com","created_at":"2026-09-13T20:59:18.192834419Z","created_by":"agent","updated_at":"2026-09-13T20:59:18.192834419Z","labels":["risk","api-contract","leakage","review"],"dependencies":[{"issue_id":"persona-5s4b.65","depends_on_id":"persona-5s4b","type":"parent-child","created_at":"2026-09-13T20:59:18.218823971Z","created_by":"agent","metadata":"{}"}]}
